configuration.title: EmberProbe: 工具与路径 / Tools & Paths

emberprobe.openocdPath.description: OpenOCD 可执行文件路径。默认在 Windows/Linux x64 使用内置版本；使用外部版本时填写 OpenOCD ≥ 0.12.0 的绝对路径。 / OpenOCD executable path. Uses the bundled version on Windows/Linux x64 by default; enter an absolute path to use external OpenOCD ≥ 0.12.0.

emberprobe.gdbPath.description: ARM GDB 可执行文件路径。 / ARM GDB executable path.

emberprobe.armToolchainPath.description: ARM 工具链的 bin 目录。 / ARM toolchain bin directory.

emberprobe.armToolchainPrefix.description: ARM 工具链前缀，留空使用 arm-none-eabi。 / ARM toolchain prefix; leave empty to use arm-none-eabi.

emberprobe.objdumpPath.description: ARM objdump 可执行文件路径。 / ARM objdump executable path.

emberprobe.cubemxPath.description: 独立 STM32CubeMX 可执行文件路径（Windows：STM32CubeMX.exe；Linux：STM32CubeMX）。在用户设置中配置，本机所有工作区共享；留空自动检测。 / Standalone STM32CubeMX executable path (Windows: STM32CubeMX.exe; Linux: STM32CubeMX). Configure in User settings for all workspaces on this machine; leave empty for automatic detection.

emberprobe.cubemx2Path.description: STM32CubeMX2 启动器路径。在用户设置中配置，本机所有工作区共享；留空时依次通过官方 Cube 注册信息或 Cube CLI、安装目录、PATH 和 Windows 快捷方式检测。 / STM32CubeMX2 launcher path. Configure in User settings for all workspaces on this machine; leave empty to detect via official Cube registration or Cube CLI, then installation directories, PATH and Windows shortcuts.

configuration.title: EmberProbe: 连接与调试 / Connection & Debugging

emberprobe.tclPort.description: 实时采样的 OpenOCD Tcl-RPC 端口。未显式设置时使用随机临时端口；显式设置后使用固定端口。Tcl 端口无认证，建议保持随机。 / OpenOCD Tcl-RPC port for live sampling. Uses a random ephemeral port unless explicitly configured. Tcl has no authentication; a random port is recommended.

emberprobe.adapterSpeedKhz.description: 调试和烧录的链路时钟（kHz）。0 使用脚本默认值，烧录时按探针能力提速，失败自动回退；非零值也限制复位事件提速，保留必要降速。 / Debug and flash adapter clock (kHz). 0 uses the script default and allows faster flashing with automatic fallback; nonzero values also cap reset-event speed increases while preserving required slowdowns.

emberprobe.transport.description: 覆盖 OpenOCD 传输协议。auto 下 J-Link 对已知 Cortex-M 目标使用 SWD，其他目标使用接口脚本默认协议；不自动切换重试。 / Override the OpenOCD transport. With auto, J-Link uses SWD for known Cortex-M targets and the interface script default for other targets; no automatic transport retry.

emberprobe.rtos.description: 调试时的 OpenOCD RTOS 感知，名称区分大小写；留空关闭。启用后调用栈显示 RTOS 任务，栈帧、变量和单步绑定对应任务。修改后需停止并重新启动调试；会话内重启不重新配置。launch.json 的 rtos 优先。 / OpenOCD RTOS awareness for debugging; names are case-sensitive and empty disables it. The call stack shows RTOS tasks with task-bound frames, variables and stepping. Stop and start debugging to apply changes; session restart reuses the server. launch.json rtos takes precedence.

emberprobe.prettyPrintingMode.description: 暂停时的 C++ 变量显示：builtin 使用内置解析，无需 Python；gdb 仅加载 prettyPrinterFiles 明确指定的脚本；raw 显示原始字段。 / Paused C++ variable display: builtin uses internal parsing without Python; gdb loads only scripts explicitly listed in prettyPrinterFiles; raw shows physical fields.

emberprobe.prettyPrinterFiles.description: gdb 显示模式加载的 Python 打印脚本，最多 32 个。相对路径基于调试工作目录解析；脚本在 GDB 内执行。 / Python printer scripts loaded in gdb display mode, up to 32 files. Relative paths resolve against the debug working directory; scripts execute inside GDB.

configuration.title: EmberProbe: 采样与波形 / Sampling & Waveforms

emberprobe.sampleFrequencyHz.description: 波形窗口目标采样频率（Hz），默认 30，范围 0.1–200。侧栏目标固定为 20 Hz；实际速率受探针吞吐能力限制。 / Target waveform sampling frequency (Hz), default 30, range 0.1–200. The sidebar targets a fixed 20 Hz; actual rates depend on probe throughput.

emberprobe.samplingAdapterSpeedKhz.description: 独立采样的链路时钟（kHz）。0 沿用 adapterSpeedKhz；非零值只用于独立采样，并限制复位事件提速。修改后自动重连，不改变调试、烧录时钟或采样频率。 / Standalone sampling adapter clock (kHz). 0 inherits adapterSpeedKhz; nonzero values apply only to standalone sampling and cap reset-event speed increases. Changes reconnect sampling without changing debug/flash clocks or sampling frequency.

emberprobe.chartHistoryMaxMiB.description: 波形历史的内存预算（MiB），包含冻结历史。耗尽时暂停全局采样并保留磁盘归档。 / Waveform history memory budget (MiB), including frozen history. Sampling pauses globally when exhausted; disk archives are retained.

emberprobe.samplingArchiveMaxMiB.description: 当前扩展会话的采样历史磁盘占用上限（MiB）。修改立即生效；调高后可重新开始因写满停止的采样。退出时自动删除归档。 / Sampling history disk limit (MiB) for the current extension session. Changes apply immediately; raising the limit allows sampling stopped by a full archive to restart. Archives are deleted on exit.

emberprobe.chartBackgroundIcon.enabled.markdownDescription: 在波形背景居中显示淡色图标。[导入/更换 PNG](command:mcu-vscode.selectChartBackgroundIcon) · [移除图标](command:mcu-vscode.removeChartBackgroundIcon)。支持透明底或纯色底 PNG；仅在本地处理，所有项目共享，不保存原图颜色和路径。 / Show a faint centered waveform background icon. [Import/replace PNG](command:mcu-vscode.selectChartBackgroundIcon) · [Remove icon](command:mcu-vscode.removeChartBackgroundIcon). Supports transparent or solid PNG backgrounds; processed locally and shared across projects. Original colors and source paths are not stored.

configuration.title: EmberProbe: RTT 日志 / RTT Logging

emberprobe.rtt.channels.markdownDescription: 要读取的 RTT up 通道，最多 16 个，例如 `[0, { "index": 1, "mode": "trim", "format": "hex" }]`。对象写法还可以设置 `format`（text、raw、hex）、`encoding` 和 `down`（输入发往的 down 通道）。省略 mode 保持固件模式；设置 mode 需要精确控制块地址和从 VS Code 启动。block 可能阻塞固件，停止 RTT 不恢复原模式。修改后手动重新启动 RTT 生效。 / RTT up channels, up to 16, e.g. `[0, { "index": 1, "mode": "trim", "format": "hex" }]`. The object form also sets `format` (text, raw, hex), `encoding` and `down` (the down channel that receives input). Omit mode to retain firmware behavior. Overrides require an exact control block address and a start from VS Code. Block can stall firmware; stopping RTT does not restore modes. Manually restart RTT to apply changes.

emberprobe.rtt.autoStart.description: 调试或实时采样会话开始时自动附加 RTT。不会为此单独打开探针；配置了通道 mode 时不自动启动。 / Attach RTT automatically when a debug or live sampling session starts. Never opens the probe for this alone, and does not start when channel modes are configured.

emberprobe.rtt.controlBlockAddress.markdownDescription: RTT 控制块地址（如 `0x24000000`）。设置后直接使用该地址，不再读取 ELF 符号或扫描；未设置时依次尝试 ELF 的 `_SEGGER_RTT` 符号、搜索范围、可写段和链接脚本 RAM 区。 / RTT control block address (such as `0x24000000`). When set it is used directly, without ELF symbols or scanning; otherwise EmberProbe tries the ELF `_SEGGER_RTT` symbol, the search range, writable sections and linker script RAM regions in turn.

address.description: 搜索范围起始地址（如 0x20000000） / Search range start address (such as 0x20000000)

size.description: 搜索范围大小（字节，十进制或 0x 十六进制，最大 16 MiB） / Search range size in bytes, decimal or 0x hexadecimal, 16 MiB at most

emberprobe.rtt.searchRange.markdownDescription: RTT 控制块搜索范围 `{ "address": "0x20000000", "size": "0x20000" }`，按 32 KiB 分片搜索，片间释放会话。优先级低于 ELF `_SEGGER_RTT` 符号，高于自动扫描。 / RTT control block search range `{ "address": "0x20000000", "size": "0x20000" }`, searched in 32 KiB slices that release the session between them. Ranks below the ELF `_SEGGER_RTT` symbol and above automatic scanning.

emberprobe.rtt.pollingIntervalMs.markdownDescription: OpenOCD 轮询 RTT 环形缓冲的间隔（毫秒），默认 10 ms。显式设置 0 使用原有 100 ms 间隔。更短间隔可能增加探针负载；手动重新启动 RTT 生效。 / How often OpenOCD polls RTT ring buffers (ms), 10 ms by default. Explicit 0 selects the former 100 ms interval. Shorter intervals can increase probe load. Manually restart RTT to apply changes.

emberprobe.rtt.encoding.markdownDescription: RTT 通道的默认文本编码，可在 `rtt.channels` 中按通道覆盖。终端输入始终按 UTF-8 发送。手动重新启动 RTT 生效。 / Default text encoding of RTT channels, overridable per channel in `rtt.channels`. Terminal input is always sent as UTF-8. Manually restart RTT to apply changes.

emberprobe.rtt.virtualTerminals.markdownDescription: 解析通道 0 上的 SEGGER 虚拟终端切换（`0xFF` + 终端号），非 0 终端的行加 `[Tn]` 前缀。通道 0 输出 latin1 二进制内容时可关闭。重新启动 RTT 生效。 / Follow SEGGER virtual terminal switches (`0xFF` + id) on channel 0 and prefix lines from terminals other than 0 with `[Tn]`. Turn off when channel 0 carries latin1 data that can contain 0xFF. Restart RTT to apply changes.

emberprobe.rtt.timestamps.description: 在 RTT 终端和日志的每行行首添加主机接收时间 [HH:MM:SS.mmm]。同一次轮询读到的行时间相同，不是固件时间。修改对运行中的终端立即生效。 / Prefix each RTT terminal and log line with the host receive time [HH:MM:SS.mmm]. Lines read in one poll share a time; this is not firmware time. Applies to running terminals immediately.

emberprobe.rtt.input.mode.description: 终端输入方式。line：本地回显和编辑，回车发送一行。raw：按键立即发送，包括控制字符，不做本地回显。修改立即生效。 / How terminals send input. line: local echo and editing, Enter sends the line. raw: keystrokes go out at once, control characters included, with no local echo. Applies immediately.

emberprobe.rtt.input.lineEnding.description: line 输入方式下附加在每行末尾的行尾。修改立即生效。 / Line ending appended to each line in line input mode. Applies immediately.

emberprobe.rtt.logFile.enabled.description: 将 RTT 输出追加保存到日志文件。修改立即生效。 / Append RTT output to a log file. Applies immediately.

emberprobe.rtt.logFile.directory.markdownDescription: RTT 日志目录，空值使用工作区根目录，相对路径从工作区解析。目录须已存在；单通道写入 `rtt.log`，多通道写入 `rtt-chN.log`。无工作区时请指定绝对路径。 / RTT log directory. Empty uses the workspace root and relative paths resolve from the workspace. The directory must exist; one channel writes `rtt.log`, several write `rtt-chN.log`. Use an absolute path when no workspace is open.

emberprobe.rtt.logFile.maxBytes.description: 单个 RTT 日志文件的字节上限；写满后轮转为 .1 备份，仅保留一个备份。 / Size limit of one RTT log file in bytes; a full file rotates to a single .1 backup.

emberprobe.rtt.logFile.raw.markdownDescription: 按接收到的原始字节保存日志，文件为 `rtt.bin`（多通道 `rtt-chN.bin`），不含时间戳和缺口标记，适合事后解码。修改立即生效。 / Save the bytes as received to `rtt.bin` (`rtt-chN.bin` with several channels), without timestamps or gap markers, for offline decoding. Applies immediately.

emberprobe.rtt.logFile.stripAnsi.description: 从 RTT 日志文件中移除 ANSI 转义序列。终端保留 ANSI 颜色。 / Remove ANSI escape sequences from RTT log files. Terminals keep ANSI colors.

emberprobe.experimental.externalGdb.enab.markdownDescription: 实验性：允许显式配置的外部 GDB 附加。使用后停止外部服务器并关闭此设置，以释放探针占用；现有调试按钮仍使用 OpenOCD。 / Experimental: allow explicitly configured external GDB attach. Stop the external server and disable this setting after use to release the probe hold; existing debug buttons still use OpenOCD.

emberprobe.experimental.externalGdb.targ.description: 实验性：外部 GDB TCP 地址，格式为 host:port 或 [IPv6]:port。显式外部附加时必填，服务器须已运行。 / Experimental: external GDB TCP target as host:port or [IPv6]:port. Required for explicit external attach; the server must already be running.

emberprobe.experimental.externalGdb.conn.description: 实验性：外部 GDB 连接模式，在附加启动时读取。修改不会切换现有会话的连接。 / Experimental: external GDB connection mode, read when attach starts. Changes do not redirect an active session.

targetName.description: Expected target name at targetProcessor; a mismatch fails startup.

executable.description: ELF file; defaults to the selected workspace ELF.

runToEntryPoint.description: Launch/restart entry point; empty keeps the target halted.

prettyPrintingMode.description: Override the paused C++ display mode for this session.

symbolFiles.description: Ordered symbol images. First is primary; omitted uses executable; [] loads no symbols. Paths resolve against cwd.

loadFiles.description: Launch downloads in order. Omitted uses executable; [] skips downloads. Attach never downloads. BIN requires address; ELF/HEX accept offset.
